name: 担当シフトの繰返しと交代操作
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate exactly ONE Lighthouse component LH11-0004 担当シフトの繰返しと交代操作, a compact floating overflow menu. Image1 is ORIGINAL Deputy source and takes higher priority for glyph geometry, proportions, spacing, alignment and fine control details. Image2 is our secondary Japanese content/layout guide, with a rough incorrect downward chevron on history. Do NOT copy that chevron: the original has a small keyboard shortcut keycap. Image3 approved bus design is only a reference for white softly elevated rounded surfaces.
Render on pure white #FFFFFF canvas, one white menu with restrained rounded corners, fine neutral edge and soft downward shadow, original small top anchor notch if visible. Keep compact logical390x390 proportions, clear regular Japanese Meiryo14/24 with zero tracking; do not enlarge text into headings. Preserve all nine rows in this exact order:
「翌日に繰り返す」
「今週の残りに繰り返す」
「曜日を選んで繰り返す」
「担当パターンを指定する」
「シフトを分割する」
thin inset neutral divider
「交代の担当者を探す」
「担当者の情報を見る」
「シフト履歴を見る」 with small neutral outlined H keycap at far right, faithful original control anatomy
thin inset neutral divider
「この担当枠を削除する」 with small neutral outlined 「削除」 keyboard-hint keycap at far right.
Align labels, paddings and row rhythm using the original menu. No leading icons: source contains none in this menu. Do not invent a save button, switches, arrows, avatars or metrics. No app chrome or surrounding schedule/popover. Keep labels regular, not bold.
Accent decision: original menu has neutral ordinary text and red destructive deletion. Retain a restrained readable red #B42318 on deletion label only because it communicates destructive intent; other labels #1D1D1D, keyboard hints #6E6E6E. No green primary action exists here so do not invent one or color rows forest green. No purple/mint/pastel fields, no random icon palette. Official white/forest/slate system remains binding where roles exist. Fine neutral dividers separate repeat/split, people/history and destructive group. Calm, readable, compact static raster candidate, not an implemented menu.
reviewNotes: 原画/モック/生成画像を実見。九項目、二分割線、原画優先の上ノッチ、履歴H/削除キー表示を復元しモックの誤シェブロンを除外。赤は削除意味だけに保持。中立の通常操作、白面、柔らかい影、日本語の全項目と切れなしを確認。正確なフォント寸法・ピクセル同等性・キーボード動作は未検証。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
